title: Mars Petcare in the doghouse for deceptive claims about Eukanuba - Federal Trade Commission (.gov)
summary: Mars Petcare in the doghouse for deceptive claims about Eukanuba Federal Trade Commission (.gov)
ai_summary: Mars Petcare faces scrutiny from the Federal Trade Commission for deceptive claims about its Eukanuba dog food brand. The FTC has issued a complaint highlighting alleged misleading statements in marketing materials.
